decls.name: ShafarevichRelationRank

paper_span.quote: pro-\(3\) extension, in the sense of Definition A.3. Then \(r(G)\le d(G)+C_0\) for an absolute constant

decls.rationale: Proposition 3.5 (Shafarevich relation-rank estimate), admitted as an axiom exactly as the paper cites it: for `F` totally real cubic (so \(\zeta_3 \notin F\)) and \(G = \mathrm{Gal}(F^{\mathrm{ur},3}/F)\), \(r(G) \le d(G) + C_0\) with \(C_0\) absolute.
